title: Always get my moneys worth
text: After getting this for 2 years, I thought I would do another review. I gave this one less star because I think the overall quality has gone down some. That said, there is almost always one full size product which is great if you can use it. I wish it was easier to decrease frequency. I have been able to skip it but most the time it comes monthly even if I think I have skipped it which is annoying. Also some of the items shown for past boxes, I sure never got. Kind of shifty.
label: positive
